comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: The “Authority Hierarchy” section reads like the verifier algorithmically resolves evidence priority across runtime/config/TRUTH docs/etc, but the script only validates paths/markers explicitly listed in the manifest. Consider rewording to clarify it’s *authoring guidance / intended evidence precedence* for maintaining the manifest, not something the verifier automatically computes.

comments.body: Automated queue-drain could not safely auto-apply this suggestion. Keeping behavior deterministic and deferring to a targeted follow-up fix.
